name: Signature.data
title: Signature.data
purpose: Data Elements are defined for each element to assist in questionnaire construction etc

element.short: The actual signature content (XML Signature, JSON Jose, picture, etc.)
element.definition: The base64 encoding of the Signature content. When signature is not recorded electronically this element would be empty.
element.comment: Where the signature type is an XML Signature, the signed content is a FHIR Resource(s). The signature can be XML Signature or JSON Jose form, e.g. XML-Signature can be generated for a Resource in JSON format.
